hooks.command: jq -r '.tool_response.filePath // .tool_input.file_path // empty' | { read -r f; case "$f" in */src/*.java) grep -q 'pgcc@helger.com' "$f" || jq -n --arg f "$f" '{systemMessage:("Missing BSD license header: "+$f), hookSpecificOutput:{hookEventName:"PostToolUse", additionalContext:($f+" is missing the BSD license header. Copy it from src/etc/license-template.txt (Philip Helger 2017-2026 + Google 2011 + Sun Microsystems 2006), or run: mvn license:format")}}' ;; esac; } 2>/dev/null || true
